summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Kevin Drew, a Canadian musician and songwriter. It states his birth date and that he co-founded the Toronto baroque-pop collective Broken Social Scene with Brendan Canning. It also notes his membership in the lesser-known duo KC Accidental with Charles Spearin, who is also a current member of Broken Social Scene.
one_line: Kevin Drew is a Canadian musician who co-founded Toronto's Broken Social Scene and was part of KC Accidental.
key_facts: Kevin Drew was born on September 9, 1976.
Kevin Drew is a Canadian musician and songwriter.
Kevin Drew, together with Brendan Canning, founded the Toronto baroque-pop collective Broken Social Scene.
Broken Social Scene is described in the note as an expansive Toronto baroque-pop collective.
Kevin Drew was part of a group called KC Accidental.
KC Accidental consisted of Kevin Drew and Charles Spearin.
Charles Spearin is described as another current member of Broken Social Scene.
KC Accidental is described in the note as a lesser-known project.
